name: adjust weights toward each misclassified example
mechanism: predict a class from the sign of a weighted sum; on each mistake move the weights toward the example (additively, or multiplicatively for the winnow variant), and stop when a pass makes no mistake

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Perceptron' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: the simplest kind of feedforward neural network: a linear classifier.
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Winnow algorithm': related to the perceptron, but uses a multiplicative weight-update scheme
